description: Paid: 0.5% of the stated amount, min $0.005, max $0.25 (e.g. $0.05 for amount=10), per call over x402. Before a larger x402 payment: the same label, allow / warn / block verdict and score as the free lumi_trust_check (paying never changes them), plus a live re-check of the seller at call time and a Lumi-signed receipt bound to the stated amount. Pass url and the USD amount you are about to pay (and optionally the payTo in its quote). The exact price for your amount is in the x402 quote (see lumi_quote).

amount.description: The USD amount you are about to pay, e.g. 10 (sets the price of this check)

payTo.description: Optional: the payTo address in its 402 quote

url.description: The x402 resource URL you are about to pay
